name: Counterparty is a non-compliant cross-chain service
description: Flows route through aggregators or bridges without KYC and with no governance accountability.
fp: Many such services are used by mainstream traders.

sources.text: FATF, Virtual Assets: Red Flag Indicators of Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing (2020)
FATF, Updated Guidance for a Risk-Based Approach to Virtual Assets and Virtual Asset Service Providers (2021)
US Department of the Treasury, Illicit Finance Risk Assessment of Decentralized Finance (2023)
